metadata.title: Curvature integral on convex hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: Let $M^n$, $n\ge3$, be the smooth, connected, complete, noncompact boundary of a closed convex set with nonempty interior in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$. We prove that its normalized scalar-curvature integral at infinity is at most $4\pi\omega_{n-2}(1-\operatorname{AVR}(M))$, except when, up to an ambient rigid motion, $M$ is the product of a smooth closed convex surface in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and $\mathbb{R}^{n-2}$. These exceptional products have zero asymptotic volume ratio and limit $8\pi\omega_{n-2}$. We also characterize the equality case for the $4\pi\omega_{n-2}(1-\operatorname{AVR}(M))$ bound. The proof uses exterior tube volumes together with the cone Steiner and Gauss--Bonnet formulas. An elementary comparison of intrinsic and Euclidean radial distances proves existence of the intrinsic limit and identifies its exact value from the cone coefficients. The same conclusions extend to orientable convex submanifolds of arbitrary codimension

analysis.progressType: 非紧凸超曲面的标量曲率积分
analysis.workSummary: 对欧氏空间中 n≥3 完整非紧凸边界，证明归一化无穷远标量曲率积分不超过 4πω_(n−2)(1−AVR)，刻画等号。闭凸二维曲面×R^(n−2) 是例外，AVR=0 而极限为 8πω_(n−2)；以 tube volume、cone Steiner 和 Gauss–Bonnet 得内在极限。
analysis.breakthrough: 将无穷远曲率质量精确联系到体积增长亏损。
analysis.limitations: 低维凸曲面乘欧氏因子的例外必须单列；高余维扩展还要求 orientable convex 子流形。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。
